candidates.title: Will Alexander Zverev win at least 1.5 more games than Ben Shelton?
candidates.rules_primary: If the game differential in favor of Alexander Zverev across the full match is above 1.5 games in the Alexander Zverev vs Ben Shelton professional tennis match in the 2026 ATP World Tour Finals Men Singles John Mcenroe Group, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary:
The following market refers to the Alexander Zverev vs Ben Shelton professional tennis match in the 2026 ATP World Tour Finals Men Singles John Mcenroe Group. If the match does not occur (signaled by a ball being played) due to a player injury, walkover, forfeiture, or any other cancellation (all before the match starts), the market will resolve to a fair price in accordance with the rules. If this match is postponed or delayed, the market will remain open and close after the rescheduled match has finished (within two weeks). If a retirement occurs, all markets that can be unconditionally settled based on play already completed will resolve accordingly.
